outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B shows representative fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a bar chart of mean with 95% CI for lactate concentration, and individual data points (dots per region) are overlaid for each group (Normal lung, LUAD, LUSC).
Panel D is a bar chart of mean with 95% CI for lactate concentration in high pH vs low pH regions, and individual data points (dots per region) are overlaid for each group.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive niche model, not a plot of averaged data.
